title: Seven acquisition signals distinguish FTFN decisions from external outcomes
summary: Five historical source interpretations and two acquisition dockets now carry FTFN classification. The 56H continuation synthesis covers eleven unchanged records, not nine; shared sources and the Dalrymple overlap do not add evidence events. Dalrymple’s historical Partially Closed label remains unchanged.
evidence_note: Individual metadata and complete-body review, with pinned historical registries and exact signal hashes. Real source statements remain attributed, not called synthetic. No external refresh, evidence-state adjudication or owner approval. All 819 earlier classification decisions are preserved.
publication_effect: Corrected current presentation and external-development feed exclusion; stable URLs, original dates and publication states retained.
